fieldValues.title: View
fieldValues.description: A named, versioned presentation over a set of Fields: which field rows appear, in what display order, under what labels, with what editor hints, and whether each is visible. It is field-centric, not Type-bound: any Record carrying the fields a View requires can be rendered through it — and it constrains presentation only. A View may not override, redefine or duplicate the semantics of any Field or Type it references.
fieldValues.notes: A row may also present a Record-level property such as lifecycle state or tags without pretending that property is a Field. Hiding a row affects rendered text only; the value stays in the Record and in any structured projection.
